title: Intro to Machine Learning
description: Learn the core ideas of machine learning and build your first models on Kaggle's official learning platform.
outcomes: Understand basic machine learning model concepts
Explore and prepare data for simple models
Build and validate introductory machine learning models
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with Python is helpful.

title: Python Certification
description: Learn Python fundamentals and complete the required projects toward freeCodeCamp's Python certification pathway.
outcomes: Understand core Python syntax and programming concepts
Work with variables, functions, data structures and control flow
Complete practical projects toward the provider's certification
prerequisites: No previous programming experience is required.

title: Introduction to Cybersecurity
provider: Cisco Networking Academy / Skills for All
description: Build foundational cybersecurity awareness, understand common threats and learn essential security practices on Cisco's official Skills for All platform.

certificate.issuer: Cisco Networking Academy / Skills for All

outcomes: Apply basic privacy and security best practices
prerequisites: No prior cybersecurity experience is required.

title: Leadership and Followership
description: Explore leadership, followership, common leadership challenges and practical ways to develop your leadership capability through OpenLearn.

title: Introduction to Mental Health Professions
shortDescription: An undergraduate introduction to psychology and the mental-health professions, including scientific inquiry, ethics, communication and professional development.
fullDescription: A competency-based NextGenU course designed for undergraduate learners exploring mental-health professions. Learners complete readings, activities, quizzes and a final assessment to earn the provider certificate.
credentialNote: NextGenU states that registration, coursework, testing and the certificate of completion are free. This is a course-completion credential, not a professional licence.
targetAudience: Undergraduate students and learners exploring mental-health careers

title: Psychiatric Clerkship for Medical Students
shortDescription: A psychiatry learning resource designed specifically for medical students, covering clinical interviewing, reasoning and common psychiatric presentations.
fullDescription: A medical-student-focused psychiatric clerkship resource organized around competencies used in psychiatry education, with quizzes, activities and a final assessment leading to a provider certificate.
credentialNote: The course is free and intended for medical students and teaching staff. Successful learners can download a NextGenU certificate of completion; it does not replace a medical-school clerkship or professional licence.
targetAudience: Medical students and hospital teaching staff

title: Global Mental Health
shortDescription: Study mental-health conditions from a global and public-health perspective, with emphasis on burden, prevention, policy and evidence-based interventions.
fullDescription: A four-module course for public-health students, practitioners and mental-health learners. Completion requirements include readings, case studies, quizzes and a final assessment.
credentialNote: NextGenU provides the course and certificate of completion at no cost. The credential documents course completion and is not a clinical practice licence.
targetAudience: Public-health students, mental-health learners and clinicians seeking global-health context

title: Mental Health Nursing
shortDescription: A nursing-focused course covering mental health, psychiatric disorders, crisis care, special populations and community mental-health nursing.
fullDescription: Designed for nursing learners, this course combines readings, case studies, quizzes and unit exams. A certificate becomes available after successful course completion.
credentialNote: NextGenU states there is no cost to take the course and the certificate of completion is downloadable after meeting the course requirements.

title: Mental Health Literacy
shortDescription: Build mental-health literacy for educational settings, including child development, supportive school environments and educator wellbeing.
fullDescription: A PAHO-supported course developed with McGill University for educators and others involved in education, with case studies, quizzes and a final assessment.
credentialNote: Course access and the certificate of completion are free. The certificate records completion and does not authorize clinical practice.
targetAudience: Teachers, school administrators and education-focused learners

title: Depression Counseling
shortDescription: An introductory course for primary-care physicians, nurses and allied-health learners on evidence-based counseling approaches for depression.
fullDescription: A health-professional training course based on the Healthy Activity Program, using readings, practice quizzes and a final assessment.
credentialNote: NextGenU states registration, learning, testing and the certificate are free. This course does not independently qualify a learner to provide mental-health treatment.
targetAudience: Primary-care, nursing and allied-health students and professionals

title: Anatomy and Physiology
shortDescription: A comprehensive foundation in human anatomy and physiology for learners preparing for medicine and other health-science fields.
fullDescription: Six modules cover body organization, movement, regulation, transport, metabolism and human development, with activities, quizzes and a final exam.
credentialNote: NextGenU provides free course access and a free certificate of completion after learners meet all completion requirements.

title: Patient Safety
shortDescription: Learn the core concepts of patient safety, quality improvement, medication safety, infection prevention and safer clinical systems.
fullDescription: A global healthcare course organized into eleven modules, with readings, reflections and quizzes that lead to a downloadable certificate.
credentialNote: The course is free to study and the certificate of completion is available after successful completion of the required activities.

title: Didactic Emergency Medicine
prerequisites: Designed for clinically prepared medical students, residents or physicians; review the provider certificate prerequisites before enrolling.
shortDescription: Foundational emergency-medicine learning for clinically prepared medical students, residents and physicians.
fullDescription: A medically focused course developed with emergency-medicine partners, covering patient management, communication and common emergency presentations.
credentialNote: All training components and the certificate are free, but NextGenU lists eligibility prerequisites for receiving the certificate. Review those requirements on the provider page.
targetAudience: Clinically prepared medical students, residents and physicians

title: Epidemiology
prerequisites: The provider states that certificate eligibility requires a college-level degree; the learning materials may still be browsed for free.
shortDescription: Build foundational epidemiology knowledge and practical skills in study design, disease measurement, critical evidence review and applied epidemiology.
fullDescription: A public-health course developed with academic and public-health partners. The learning experience includes readings, quizzes, peer activities and a final assessment.
credentialNote: Registration, learning, testing and the certificate are free. NextGenU states a college-level degree is required for certificate eligibility on this course.
targetAudience: Health-science and public-health learners with the provider's certificate prerequisite

title: Mpox – Prevention, Response, and Care for Health Professionals
shortDescription: A practical course on Mpox recognition, prevention, infection control, patient care and community response for health professionals and students.
fullDescription: Five concise modules combine public-health and clinical-response concepts with quizzes and a final exam for health professionals, students and community health workers.
credentialNote: GHLC states its courses are free and successful learners receive a free digital certificate. The platform is open to the public.
targetAudience: Health professionals, medical and health students, public-health staff and community health workers

title: Malaria
shortDescription: Learn core strategies for malaria prevention, diagnosis, treatment and global programme response.
fullDescription: A Global Health Learning Center course focused on practical malaria knowledge for global-health and clinical learners.
credentialNote: GHLC courses are free, open to the public and issue a free digital certificate after the learner completes the course requirements.
targetAudience: Medical, nursing, public-health and global-health learners

title: Tuberculosis Basics
shortDescription: A foundation in global tuberculosis epidemiology, prevention strategies and core programme approaches.
fullDescription: A short Global Health Learning Center course for learners who want a practical introduction to tuberculosis prevention and control.
credentialNote: GHLC courses are free, open to the public and provide a free digital certificate after successful completion.
targetAudience: Medical, nursing, public-health and community-health learners

title: Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care
shortDescription: Study essential interventions and programme approaches for obstetric and newborn emergencies in global-health settings.
fullDescription: A maternal and newborn health course focused on essential emergency-care interventions and implementation lessons for health workers and students.
credentialNote: GHLC states course access is free and a free digital certificate is issued after course requirements are completed.
targetAudience: Medical, nursing, midwifery and maternal-health learners

title: Nutrition: An Introduction
shortDescription: A broad introduction to nutrition challenges and interventions across maternal, child and global-health settings.
fullDescription: A foundational global-health nutrition course for students and professionals who want to strengthen public-health and programme knowledge.
credentialNote: GHLC courses are free and open to the public, with a free digital certificate after successful completion.
targetAudience: Health-science, nutrition, nursing and public-health learners
